# P2P Media Loader

`crates/server/src/web/assets/p2p-media-loader-hlsjs.min.js` is the published
`dist/p2p-media-loader-hlsjs.iife.min.js` from the npm package
`p2p-media-loader-hlsjs@4.0.0` (Novage), copied without modification.
The published package is Apache-2.0; its license is alongside this notice.
Its bundled core also uses Apache-2.0, and the bundled `debug` dependency
uses MIT (see `LICENSE.debug`).
The asset is embedded in the Plamenu binary and loaded only when a compatible
HLS video is played with peer sharing enabled. No CDN or runtime package
installation is required.
